notes.title: Walk-through Videos
notes.content:
Hello fellow adventurers,

Dungeon Adventure can be quite a hard game for someone who is unfamiliar with its mechanics. Therefore, I will be posting walk-through videos to help out.

First walk-through video is available here: https://youtu.be/tqDNQBZJYU8

Cheers,

Sean

notes.title: Release Announcement
notes.content:
Hello friends,

Dungeon Adventure is coming out later today. Although I only have one announcement before release if you're reading this, you probably have my game on wishlist. That counts as a friend in my book.

I have walked a long and emotional journey to this moment. I can't say love every moment of it but I appreciate every bit of it. And I think the game has come to a point that it's enjoyable as a small game at this stage. Like me, you will encounter some problems. I will appreciate it if you report them [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/834100/discussions/]here[/url] or to support@peasantstudio.com. I will read every post or email and address as many of them as I can.

I started making this game because I find fast-paced puzzle game very relaxing. I designed the battles to capture your focus for a few minutes. A mistake can be very costly. If you find the game too challenging, you should try again from the beginning (I swear it will be easier). I hope that everyone has fun playing as much as I do and thank you for playing my game.

notes.title: Demo Version is available on Play store
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I'm happy to announce that our demo version is available to play on Play store.
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.PeasantStudio.DAD

The demo contains the first 2 levels of the game. I hope you enjoy our demo.

Cheers.
